steps.text: Hey 😊 First morning without the cast, how does it feel?
Strange actually
I woke up and moved the blanket like I still had to make room for it
You got attached to it 😭
We spent a lot of time together
Should I be jealous?
It was a very supportive relationship
Oh my god
You've been saving that one since yesterday, haven't you
Since the doctor took it off
And I walked straight into it
Thank you for making this possible
You're welcome, unfortunately 😌
But seriously, are you comfortable?
Mostly. It still feels stiff when I get up
Not exactly ready to sprint down the street
Good, because I wasn't going to chase you
Not even a little?
I'd walk after you with a very disappointed expression
Wait, this is the face you'd be getting
Terrifying
It works on you
It really does
I'm just happy it's finally off ❤️
When I saw your message yesterday, I wanted to come over and hug you
That offer still available?
Obviously
Although I also want an afternoon with you where neither of us spends half of it asking about your leg
We could find a small café somewhere, when I'm up to it
I'd like that
I miss sitting across from you and stealing something off your plate
Beautiful. That's what you miss about me
Among other things
But mostly your terrible habit of ordering something nicer than mine
You always say you're not hungry
I'm not hungry until your food arrives
Completely different situation 😌
Speaking of food, have you had breakfast?
Coffee
That's a drink
Look who's suddenly responsible
I learned from a very strict woman
She sounds lovely
Annoying. Very pretty though
That saved you ❤️
Wait, I'll prove I'm eating
2 MINUTES LATER
Toast, coffee, and a woman who is definitely going to be late if she keeps texting you
You look lovely
You were supposed to notice the toast
I noticed both
I'll allow it
Classes all day?
This morning, then some work with my group after lunch
We spent twenty minutes yesterday deciding who was supposed to send a document everyone already had
Promising start
Exactly. I'm bringing snacks and lowering my expectations
Sounds like you're the only one prepared
Emotionally, absolutely not
And I haven't forgotten what we talked about last night
I want to think about the first step properly, not while I'm trying to find my other shoe
I'd hate to compete with the shoe
It's currently winning
2 MINUTES LATER
Found it. Both shoes are on, so now I have no excuse
One last picture before I leave, since you can't be here to distract me in person
You're making it very hard to encourage you to leave
You're supposed to wish me luck, not make me miss you
I can do both
I know you can ❤️
Text me when you have a quiet moment
I will ❤️
And keep some room in your schedule for that hug
I'll cancel my appointment with the sofa
Tell it I'm sorry 😌
